description: Request that a real person attempts a task on a website or app, records the screen and reports friction points. A commissioned job: a skilled, accountable human we brief for you – quoted individually, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

persona.description: Optional: who the tester should be, e.g. non-technical person aged 60+.

task.description: What the tester should try to achieve.

url.description: https URL of the site or app (or store link).
